onboarding.title: New here? Start with one tutorial match
onboarding.copy: Jump straight into a practice match and learn while playing: start from your capital, expand, then capture enemy capitals.

tutorialAutoStart.title: Entering practice match
tutorialAutoStart.copy: Follow the top guide once the match begins: move out from your capital, expand, then capture enemy capitals.
tutorialAutoStart.waitingHost: Waiting for host to start the tutorial...

tutorialGuide.cityHint: Cities and capitals produce 1 unit every turn, so grabbing a city early is usually worth it.
tutorialGuide.captureHint: After one capital falls, keep looking for the next one. You win when every enemy capital is yours.
tutorialGuide.moveHint: You can move with WASD, arrow keys, mouse clicks, or mobile drag. A tile needs at least 2 units to move because 1 unit must stay behind.

first_move.title: Learn the basic move
first_move.copy: Your capital is already selected. Move into a neighboring tile now. You can only move from your own land, and a tile needs at least 2 units because 1 unit always stays behind.

grow_income.title: Spread out to grow faster
grow_income.copy: Plains produce 1 unit every 25 turns, so more land means faster growth. Expand first, then pick stronger fights.

split_army.title: Try a half-army move
split_army.copy: Press Z to send half your army, then move again. It helps you expand without emptying the tile behind you.

hunt_king.title: Capture enemy capitals
hunt_king.copy: Your goal is to capture every enemy capital. When one falls, all of that player's land and army become yours, but the army is halved.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
howToPlay.goal: Your goal is to capture every opponent's capital (crown tile).
howToPlay.plains: Plains produce 1 unit every 25 turns. Expanding territory helps you build up faster.
howToPlay.cities: Cities and capitals produce 1 unit every turn
howToPlay.moves: You can move twice per turn.
howToPlay.capture: When you capture an enemy capital, their territory becomes yours instantly (army is halved).
howToPlay.how-to-toggle-50: Z / Click Twice / Mobile: Quick Double Touch
howToPlay.wsad: WSAD / ArrowKey / MouseClick / TouchDrag on Mobile
howToPlay.beginnerTutorial: If this is your first match, start Tutorial from the lobby and learn step by step in-game.
